children: Coherent Corp. (COHR) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on August 31, 2026.

The information set forth in Item 8.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K under the headings "Performance Stock Units", "Shareholder-Aligned Award Design", and "Shareholder-Aligned Termination Provisions" is incorporated by reference into this Item 5.02.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820318/000119312526375462/d110649d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820318/000119312526375462/0001193125-26-375462-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
